title: We Do Not Care
blurb: Not rude, exactly — administrative. The matter has been reviewed, a determination has been reached, and you are being informed of the outcome. That bureaucratic calm is what makes the clip so much more devastating than a straightforward insult would be; there is no anger to push back against. TikTok made it the official response to unsolicited opinions, minor drama, and explanations nobody requested. Play it when somebody begins a story you can already tell will not repay the investment. Case closed.
origin: A viral TikTok audio adopted as the official dismissal of unwanted information.
